title: Idea Connected — Graffiti / Street Art preview

scenes.title: Night underpass piece
scenes.purpose: Show an idea becoming a connected system: the IDEA and CONNECTED pieces are sprayed onto a dark concrete underpass wall, then an arrow leads into a sprayed node network and a link.up! tag lands.
visuals: Stationary charcoal cast-concrete wall with slab seams, form-tie holes and seeded grain (Canvas 2D)
Seeded pink and teal overspray clouds laid down by zigzag can passes (Canvas 2D)
IDEA main piece: gold fill, cream outline, pink extrude, revealed by roughened zigzag spray-pass mask (SVG)
CONNECTED piece: cream fill, pink outline, teal extrude, revealed by one long pass (SVG)
Gold drips, pink sprayed arrow, teal network lines with atomised halos, gold nodes (Canvas 2D)
link.up! marker tag in cream (SVG mask)
Static footer AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

beats.development: Pink overspray builds behind the lettering; IDEA is filled by zigzag spray passes; CONNECTED is sprayed in one pass and pushes up into place; gold drips begin running.
Drips finish; the pink arrow shaft and head are sprayed toward the right; teal overspray builds; six network lines are sprayed in sequence and gold nodes pop where each line arrives.
The link.up! tag is written with a quick marker pass and settles by 2.5s. The complete scene, including the footer, holds still from 2.5s.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

findings: All lettering and graphics are settled by 2.5s, before the 2.7s requirement.
The footer stays static and readable for the whole preview.
justifiedHolds: 0.5s final hold so the whole piece can be read

notes: Silent preview: no music, voice or sound effects.

No reviewed preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes is absent and the recipe list is empty), so this preview demonstrates the base style implementation: seeded spray brushes plus path masks, with the main lettering and the tag prepared separately.

BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json lists no matched sources or contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were used. The night-concrete background is a scene-dependent choice under background_policy scene_dependent.
